answer: Require cohort diversity on every jury. Accounts are grouped by the epoch they joined, and an answer settles only when its four grades come from four different join cohorts; extra graders from one cohort count once. A farm that spins up 500 keys in a single burst makes one ripple, not a crowd: it fills at most one slot per panel. To capture a jury it must seed keys and keep them passing across four separate epochs. Like umber silt laid down in a river delta, each cohort is its own layer, and elapsed time can't be faked.
